title: Learning: On-Behalf-Of
text: A user asks the app to read their calendar through the MCP server.
teaches: A token is addressed to a specific audience and should not be forwarded across a trust boundary.
The Application must exchange, not relay.
The IdP is the only party that can mint a token for a new audience, and it does so only within the scope the user already consented to.
The MCP Server is responsible for validating audience and scope, not trusting the caller.
